origin.summary: Workout 6 of the 2011 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: A 7-minute ascending-rep couplet of thrusters and chest-to-bar pull-ups, climbing by threes (3-6-9 up to 21) for as many rounds as possible.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2011/6 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09; ascending ladder (+3 reps each round); pattern continues indefinitely until the 7-minute cap
